reuse.why: Reuses extractTagsFromText for the #fixed tag, getSheetValue/setBudget and the undoable mutator pattern, and replaces three copied SQL queries with one getMonthActionCategories helper.

duplication.why: The skip rule is in one predicate, but the group-notes/has_templates join and projection is written twice (getMonthActionCategories and getBudgetData), and the income/tracking check is still repeated in every action.

placement.why: All selection logic lives in server/budget/actions.ts with the actions, and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts like its siblings.

scope.why: Only the month-wide actions, their shared selection, the new handler and tests are touched; single-category actions are left alone.

maintainability.why: One predicate with an explicit includeHiddenCategories option is easy to own; the second SQL copy in getBudgetData and the per-site income check are small residual risks.

abstraction_drift.where: isSkippedByMonthAction gained the includeHiddenCategories parameter (requested variation); every month-wide action, including copyPreviousMonth via getBudgetData's extended projection, calls it; no special-case branches.
